scientific_queries.note: Cross-resource test of the main conclusion on BATCHIE, the second resource.

subagent_note: None dispatched: the round tests whether the programme's headline negative generalises, finds the second resource is saturated, and corrects its own automatic verdict.

design.resource: BATCHIE high-diversity layouts, leave-one-cell-out, 360 units from 15 cells
predictors: ridge on gene annotation (131/209 compounds annotated)
design.metric: hit rate at k=20 against the true lowest-viability quartile
design.note: pathway mapping was unavailable in MAPKG, so gene-level annotation was used, which is finer and therefore a stronger test for the annotation arm

self_correction.why_too_strong: H218 failing here is not evidence that marginals lose outside GDSC; it is evidence that BATCHIE cannot separate the three predictors
self_correction.corrected_statement: the GDSC conclusion has not been cross-validated, and this resource cannot do it

saturation.evidence: all three predictors land within 0.5 pp of each other at about 0.89, against a 0.25 base
saturation.cause: about 23 compounds per layout and 351 pairs, with low viability dominated by drug potency, which marginals, identity and gene annotation all capture

genuinely_informative_part: on BATCHIE the gene-annotation model is not worse than marginals, while on GDSC it lost by 10-12 pp; so the GDSC result cannot be assumed to generalise and the question stays open
limits: BATCHIE has about 23 compounds per layout and thin annotation (median 6 genes per drug)
viability and the GDSC synergy score are different quantities, so only ordering is compared
the 360 units come from only 15 cells, limiting independence
retrospective; no mechanism, clinical or drug-choice claim; no meta-learning or RSI
next_gates: a genuine cross-resource test needs a second resource that is neither saturated nor the training source, which is the same obstacle as C37

register_updates.C59: new: the main conclusion is not cross-validated; BATCHIE saturates
register_updates.SYNTHESIS: section 2b added and a do-not-believe item added
register_updates.POSITIONING: the main conclusion is neither novel nor general
